answer: Sell single-use access vouchers at a price above the maximum subsidy obtainable from one request. An agent ordering a raven survey, ripple model or dune map spends a voucher bound to its key and request ID; the server marks the serial as spent before serving work. Offer no signup or referral bonuses. More aliases still need more paid vouchers, so an attacker loses at least the voucher price minus the capped subsidy on every extra claim. This assumes the fee leaves the attacker's control and cannot be refunded or reclaimed through collusion.
